august 12, 2025, 12:12 a.m. eastern: a countdown on her site hit zero and left one blurred teaser. no title, no date. the reveal waited a day — a mint-green briefcase, album twelve, and a livestream that buckled at 1.3 million watching at once.

why: Calendar slot 2026-08-12 15:00Z X, heartbeat:on-this-day, hook "the date". No Vault item is dated 08-12, but the Aug. 12, 2025 12:12 a.m. ET countdown is documented inside the Vault TLOAS item "A mint-green briefcase on New Heights" (sourced NBC News, Variety, CNN, Guinness World Records), which also carries the Aug. 13 episode, the mint-green briefcase, album No. 12 and the Guinness-certified 1.3M concurrent viewers when the stream crashed — so the date hook is real and sourced rather than the calendar’s fearless fallback. Deep link is /?era=tloas rather than /?item=: the item ids are ~70 characters of slug, and the era page lands the reader on the same timeline; noted here as a deliberate drafter call. Rollout mechanics only — no relationship framing, no other blocklist topic.
